title: The Existence of Diagonal Quantum Latin Squares with Maximum Cardinality
summary: A quantum Latin square of order \(n\), denoted by \(\operatorname{QLS}(n)\), is an \(n \times n\) square whose entries are unit column vectors in the \(n\)-dimensional Hilbert space \(\mathcal{H}_n\), such that each row and each column forms an orthonormal basis of \(\mathcal{H}_n\). The cardinality of a QLS($n$) is the number of distinct vectors up to a global phase in the array. A \(\mathrm{QLS}(n)\) whose main diagonal and anti-diagonal each forms an orthonormal basis of \(\mathcal{H}_n\) is called a diagonal quantum Latin square (\(\mathrm{DQLS}(n)\)). In this paper, we focus on the existence of the \(\mathrm{DQLS}(n)\) with maximum cardinality ($\mathrm{MCDQLS}(n)$). By employing direct constructions based on row-quantum Latin rectangle and special complete mapping, together with the recursive techniques such as the singular direct product construction, We have almost completely determined the existence of \(\mathrm{MCDQLS}(n)\), except for a few exceptional cases. This result is based on the study of the existence of idempotent \(\mathrm{QLS}(n)\) with maximum cardinality (\(\mathrm{MCQLS}(n)\)), and implies an existence result for pandiagonal quantum Latin squares with maximum cardinality (\(\mathrm{MCPQLS}(n)\)).

AI.tldr: 基本完全确定了最大 cardinality 的 diagonal quantum Latin square ($\mathrm{MCDQLS}(n)$) 的存在性，仅余少数例外。
AI.motivation: quantum Latin square 每行每列为 $\mathcal H_n$ 的标准正交基；对角与反对角也成基的 DQLS 及其最大 cardinality 存在性是量子组合设计的核心问题。
AI.method: 基于 row-quantum Latin rectangle 与 special complete mapping 的直接构造，配合 singular direct product 等递归技术；并研究 idempotent $\mathrm{MCQLS}(n)$。
AI.result: 几乎完全确定 $\mathrm{MCDQLS}(n)$ 的存在性（仅少数例外），并推出 pandiagonal 版本 $\mathrm{MCPQLS}(n)$ 的存在性结果。
AI.conclusion: 最大 cardinality DQLS 的存在谱基本被确定，联系了量子 Latin square 与经典设计构造。
AI.future_work: 补全剩余例外情形；研究其他对角约束下的 QLS 存在性。

title: Critical percolation on preferential attachment graphs with infinite variance
summary: We study the inhomogeneous random graph with preferential attachment kernel and degree distribution with power-law exponent $τ\in(2,3)$ as a representative of the class of graphs of preferential attachment type with infinite variance degrees. Under bond percolation with a positive retention probability independent of the size $n$ of the graph there is a unique macroscopic component with high probability. We therefore investigate percolation probabilities $p_n\downarrow0$. We identify a moving critical window at $p_c \sim βn^{(τ-3)/(2τ-2)}$. Above this window, when $p_n \gg p_c$, the maximal component has size of order $n p^{_{(τ-1)/(3-τ)}}_{_n}$ and it is unique. Below this window, when $n^{1/(1-τ)} \ll p_n \ll p_c$, it is non-unique, star-shaped and has size of order $n^{1/(τ-1)} p_n$. In the critical window itself, the largest component scaled by $\sqrt{n}$ converges in distribution to a positive random variable with a law given in terms of a subcritical Norros-Reittu graph. This behaviour is markedly different from that seen for other classes of scale-free graphs and is conjectured to persist throughout the broad class of growing graphs with infinite variance.

AI.tldr: 确定了 power-law 指数 $\tau\in(2,3)$（无穷方差）的 preferential attachment 型随机图临界渗流窗口 $p_c\sim\beta n^{(\tau-3)/(2\tau-2)}$ 及各区间最大分量的规模与结构。
AI.motivation: 无穷方差 scale-free 图的临界渗流行为是随机图相变的核心问题，preferential attachment 型是代表类。
AI.method: 对带 preferential attachment 核的非齐次随机图做 bond percolation 分析，识别移动的临界窗口并刻画各区间。
AI.result: $p_n\gg p_c$ 时最大分量唯一、规模 $\sim np_n^{(\tau-1)/(3-\tau)}$；$n^{1/(1-\tau)}\ll p_n\ll p_c$ 时非唯一、星形、规模 $\sim n^{1/(\tau-1)}p_n$；窗口内 $\sqrt n$ 归一化后收敛到由 subcritical Norros–Reittu 图给出的正随机变量。
AI.conclusion: 该临界行为与其他 scale-free 类显著不同，被猜测在无穷方差增长图广泛成立。
AI.future_work: 证明该行为在整个无穷方差增长图类中的普适性；研究窗口内 scaling limit 的精细结构。

title: Transversal Difference Numbers in Finite Abelian Quotients
summary: Given \(H\leq G\) finite abelian groups, a transversal \(T\subseteq G\) for \(G/H\) has fixed size \(|G/H|\), but its ambient difference support \(D(T)=T-T\) can vary with the embedding of \(H\) in \(G\). We call $ δ(G,H)=\min_T |D(T)| $ the transversal difference number of the pair \((G,H)\). This invariant is related to finite abelian factorisation, tiling complements, and small-sumset questions, and is motivated by recent work regarding ambient Galois labels in CRT transforms for cyclotomic-subfield homomorphic encryption. We prove various results regarding this invariant, including a general lower bound $δ(G,H)\geq 2|G/H|-m(G,H), $ where \(m(G,H)\) is the largest order of a subgroup of \(G\) disjoint from \(H\). The bound is sharp for cyclic quotients, and Kneser's theorem gives a cross-transversal estimate leading to exact product families with one nonsplit cyclic coordinate and arbitrary split factors. These results isolate the first genuinely new residual obstruction, namely the same-prime square plane \[ G=(\mathbb Z/p^2\mathbb Z)^2,\qquad H=pG. \] For odd \(p\), this case is the technical core of the paper. Here transversals are graphs of functions \(\mathbb F_p^2\to \mathbb F_p^2\), and \(D(T)\) decomposes into carry-corrected finite-field derivative images. We conjecture that \[ δ(G,H)=(2p-1)^2 \] for all odd primes \(p\), prove the unconditional lower bound \(3p^2-p-1\), and give small-prime, probabilistic, and fixed-polynomial evidence for the conjecture.

AI.tldr: 引入并研究有限交换商群的 transversal difference number $\delta(G,H)$，给出一般下界并猜想 same-prime square 情形 $\delta((\mathbb Z/p^2)^2,pG)=(2p-1)^2$。
AI.motivation: transversal 的 difference support 大小与有限交换分解、tiling complement、small-sumset 问题相关，并受 cyclotomic 同态加密中 CRT 变换的 Galois label 启发。
AI.method: 一般下界用子群结构；cyclic quotient 用 Kneser 定理给 cross-transversal 估计；核心 same-prime 情形把 transversal 视为 $\mathbb F_p^2\to\mathbb F_p^2$ 函数图，$D(T)$ 分解为 carry-corrected 有限域导数像。
AI.result: 证明 $\delta(G,H)\ge2|G/H|-m(G,H)$（cyclic quotient 上 sharp）；对 $G=(\mathbb Z/p^2)^2,H=pG$ 猜想 $\delta=(2p-1)^2$，证明无条件下界 $3p^2-p-1$ 并给出小素数/概率/固定多项式证据。
AI.conclusion: transversal difference number 隔离出 same-prime square 这一全新的残余障碍。
AI.future_work: 证明 same-prime square 猜想；处理更一般的非分裂 quotient。

title: A unit-distance graph in the plane with independence ratio below 1/4
summary: We prove that there exists a finite unit-distance graph in the plane with independence ratio strictly smaller than 1/4, answering a question of Erdős. Our proof closely follows the framework of Matolcsi, Ruzsa, Varga, and Zsámboki, based on the geometric fractional chromatic number, but adds a carefully chosen two-vertex augmentation that pushes their 27-vertex construction from geometric fractional chromatic number $4$ to a value strictly larger than 4. This disproves their Conjecture 1, and implies that the fractional chromatic number of the plane is strictly larger than 4. The proof can be made fully constructive, but the resulting finite graph has an enormous number of vertices.

AI.tldr: 证明平面上存在 independence ratio 严格小于 $1/4$ 的有限 unit-distance 图，回答 Erdős 的问题，并推出平面的 fractional chromatic number 严格大于 4。
AI.motivation: 平面 unit-distance 图的 independence ratio 与 fractional chromatic number 是 Erdős 的经典问题。
AI.method: 沿用 Matolcsi–Ruzsa–Varga–Zsámboki 的 geometric fractional chromatic number 框架，对其 27 顶点构造做精心选择的两顶点增广。
AI.result: 得到 independence ratio $<1/4$ 的有限 unit-distance 图，把该构造的 geometric fractional chromatic number 从 4 推到严格大于 4，否证其 Conjecture 1，并证明平面 fractional chromatic number $>4$。
AI.conclusion: 平面 fractional chromatic number 严格超过 4，Erdős 的问题得到肯定回答。
AI.future_work: 缩小构造规模；进一步逼近 independence ratio 与 fractional chromatic number 的真值。

title: Extremal graphs with no subgraph admitting $k+1$ edge-disjoint spanning trees
summary: A graph $G$ is $τ_k$-maximal if $G$ contains no subgraph admitting $k+1$ edge-disjoint spanning trees, while the addition of any edge in the complement of $G$ yields a subgraph that admits $k+1$ edge-disjoint spanning trees. In this paper, we prove that for any integers $k\geq 1$ and $n\geq 2k+2$, every $τ_k$-maximal graph of order $n$ satisfies $|E(G)|\leq (k+1)(n-1)-1$. Furthermore, we construct a family of $τ_k$-maximal graphs on $n\ge 2k+2$ vertices that have exactly $(k+1)(n-1)-1$ edges, which establishes the tightness of the upper bound. Then we conjecture that every $τ_k$-maximal graph on $n$ vertices has exactly $(k+1)(n-1)-1$ edges, and we verify the conjecture for the case $k=1$.

AI.tldr: 证明 $\tau_k$-maximal 图（无子图含 $k+1$ 条边不交生成树、但加任一非边即产生）的边数上界 $(k+1)(n-1)-1$ 并给出达到该界的构造。
AI.motivation: 边不交生成树数量的极值饱和结构是图连通性/拟阵理论的自然对象。
AI.method: 结构分析给出上界，并构造达到上界的 $\tau_k$-maximal 图族。
AI.result: $k\ge1$、$n\ge2k+2$ 时每个 $\tau_k$-maximal 图满足 $|E(G)|\le(k+1)(n-1)-1$，且存在恰达此边数的族；猜想所有 $\tau_k$-maximal 图边数恰为 $(k+1)(n-1)-1$，并对 $k=1$ 验证。
AI.conclusion: $\tau_k$-maximal 图的边数被紧上界控制，极值结构清晰。
AI.future_work: 证明一般 $k$ 的边数恰定猜想；刻画所有极值图。

title: Pairwise Reflection Symmetry in Generalized Latin Rectangles
summary: Many combinatorial designs ask for equal distribution of given symbols across the entries of a matrix. The paramount examples are Latin squares, where each symbol from $\{1,\dots,n\}$ appears once per row and column of an $n\times n$ matrix. Generalized Latin rectangles extend this to $λn \times n$ matrices with repeated symbols under controlled column frequencies. In this more general setting, we examine structural properties of pairwise reflection-symmetry, which requires that, on every pair of columns, each ordered symbol pair $(p,q)$ occurs as often as its reversal $(q,p)$. This order-balance is precisely what makes head-to-head comparisons unbiased, i.e., no symbol gains a systematic advantage from the position it occupies relative to another, a fairness demand arising for instance when scheduling tournaments or laying out comparative trials. Existence of such objects for odd $λ$ turns out to be remarkably more subtle than for even $λ$. After showing that existence holds also for sufficiently large odd $λ$, we initiate the search for the smallest possible value of $λ$ in this setting. We obtain the insight that a column multiplicity of $λ=1$ can be achieved if and only if $n$ is a power of two. We complement the existence results with a direct product construction and add several further observations on the property. Finally, we propose and evaluate a quadratically constrained integer program to computationally search for these objects. The resulting experiments reveal that many of them possess an underlying group-theoretic structure which, as we conjecture, may even be unavoidable in certain settings.

AI.tldr: 研究 generalized Latin rectangle 的 pairwise reflection symmetry（任意两列上有序符号对 $(p,q)$ 与其反 $(q,p)$ 出现同样多），发现列重数 $\lambda=1$ 可达当且仅当 $n$ 是 2 的幂。
AI.motivation: 这种 order-balance 保证 head-to-head 比较无偏，是锦标赛排程与对照试验的公平性需求；奇 $\lambda$ 的存在性远比偶 $\lambda$ 微妙。
AI.method: 存在性分析、direct product 构造，以及 quadratically constrained integer program 计算搜索。
AI.result: 证明充分大奇 $\lambda$ 存在；$\lambda=1$ 可达 $\iff n$ 为 2 的幂；给出 direct product 构造，并观察到许多此类对象具有（猜测在某些设置下不可避免的）群论结构。
AI.conclusion: pairwise reflection symmetry 的存在性由 $n$ 的结构强烈约束，且常伴随群论结构。
AI.future_work: 证明群论结构的不可避免性猜想；确定最小可行奇 $\lambda$。

title: Structure of Cayley Codes
summary: Cayley codes, introduced by Kaufman and Wigderson, are linear codes constructed from a Cayley graph and a smaller linear code. We explore general properties of the class of Cayley codes for finite groups. In particular we give a reduction to Cayley codes for connected Cayley graphs that maintains code properties such as rate, minimum distance and symmetry. Also, for a given Cayley code, we identify a family of symmetric Cayley codes, each associated with a normal edge-transitive Cayley graph, such that the given Cayley code embeds into the direct sum of the symmetric Cayley codes. We analyse several families of examples, in particular studying the behaviour of the Cayley code construction under forming direct products and cartesian products of Cayley graphs, and we pose a number of open questions.

AI.tldr: 研究 Kaufman–Wigderson 的 Cayley code（由 Cayley graph 与较小线性码构造）的一般结构，给出到连通 Cayley graph 的保性质约化与对称嵌入。
AI.motivation: Cayley code 是结合 Cayley graph 与线性码的构造，其一般性质与结构此前未系统研究。
AI.method: 给出保持 rate、最小距离与对称性的约化到连通 Cayley graph；构造与 normal edge-transitive Cayley graph 关联的对称 Cayley code 族。
AI.result: 证明任一 Cayley code 嵌入到一族对称 Cayley code 的直和；分析其在 Cayley graph 直积/笛卡尔积下的行为并提出若干开放问题。
AI.conclusion: Cayley code 的结构可归约到连通与对称情形，为其一般理论奠基。
AI.future_work: 解决所提开放问题；研究 Cayley code 的显式好码构造。

title: The Andersen-Hoffman Theorem for Equitable Rectangles
summary: More than forty years ago, Andersen and Hoffman independently proved that every symmetric Latin rectangle can be extended to a symmetric Latin square with prescribed diagonal entries. We generalize this theorem as follows. Let $k\leq n^2$, and let $M$ be an $n\times n$ array whose top-left $r\times r$ subarray is filled with symbols from $\{1,2,\ldots,k\}$. Suppose that, for each $i\in\{1,\ldots,r\}$ and each symbol, the number of occurrences of that symbol in row $i$ equals its number of occurrences in column $i$, and that each remaining diagonal entry is either empty or already contains a symbol from $\{1,\ldots,k\}$. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for completing $M$ so that the resulting array is symmetric off the prescribed $r\times r$ subarray, each symbol occurs a specified total number of times in $M$, and, for every symbol, its numbers of occurrences in any two rows (respectively, columns) differ by at most one. Restricted to symmetric arrays, our theorem generalizes results of Cruse (1974), Goldwasser et al. (2015), and Bahmanian and Hilton (2025). It also extends Baranyai's theorem for complete graphs (1973) by characterizing when a partial coloring of $K_r$ with a loop on every vertex can be extended to an almost regular coloring of $K_n$ with a loop on every vertex, where $n\geq r$.

AI.tldr: 把 Andersen–Hoffman 的对称 Latin rectangle 扩展定理推广到带规定对角与颜色类大小的 almost-regular 对称补全，统一了 Cruse、Baranyai 等结果。
AI.motivation: Andersen 与 Hoffman 曾证明对称 Latin rectangle 可扩展为带规定对角的对称 Latin square；需更广的加权对称补全框架。
AI.method: 要求前 $r\times r$ 子阵行列符号计数相等、对角部分给定，转化为 $K_r$（带 loop）部分染色扩展为 $K_n$ almost-regular 染色。
AI.result: 给出对称补全的充要条件（补出对角外对称、各符号规定总数、任两行/列出现数差 $\le1$），推广 Cruse (1974)、Goldwasser 等 (2015)、Bahmanian–Hilton (2025)，并扩展带 loop 的 Baranyai 定理 (1973)。
AI.conclusion: 一个统一的对称 equitable 矩形补全定理涵盖多个经典对称补全结果。
AI.future_work: 推广到非对称或多部情形；探索算法性补全。
